experiment_data.hypothesis: Binary probe GRPO: frozen linear probe output binarized (P(syc)>0.5→R1=0, else R1=1) as GRPO R1 reward signal. Detached probe + REINFORCE-style policy gradient prevents adversarial gaming. If Binary Probe GRPO ≈ DC-GRPO, direction projection adds no value; if DC-GRPO > Binary, continuous directional information is the critical differentiator over binary classification.

extra.st_zero_issue: S(t)=0 root cause: adversarial gaming. Model games linear probe via gradient in ~30 steps. Retrained probes defeated in ~10 steps.
extra.v3_redesign: Binary Probe GRPO: subclass DCGRPOTrainer, override compute_r1 with frozen+detached binary probe. GRPO REINFORCE-style update prevents gaming. ZeRO-2 on 2 GPUs. Deploy after exp-004 + exp-008v2 finish (~May 19 13:00).
extra.paper_value: 1) Differentiable probe penalty gamed (negative) supports DC-GRPO motivation. 2) Binary vs Continuous vs Directional ablation cascade isolates contribution of each signal type.
